name: GL_HISTORICAL_RATES
description: GL_HISTORICAL_RATES contains information about historical foreign currency translation rates. This table corresponds to the Historical Rates form. RATE_TYPE is 'H' for historical, 'C' for calculated, 'P' for prior, or 'E' for period.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier. It is a foreign key to the GL_LEDGRES.LEDGER_ID table.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Historical rate accounting period .

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Historical rate accounting period number.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Historical rate accounting period year.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield combination defining column.

columns.name: TARGET_CURRENCY
columns.description: Target currency of historical rate.

columns.name: UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether the historical rate is updated.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate type lookup.

columns.name: TRANSLATED_RATE
columns.description: User entered historical conversion rate.

columns.name: TRANSLATED_AMOUNT
columns.description: User entered historical amount .

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Account type of the historical account. For example, Asset and Liability.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE1
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE2
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE3
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE4
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE5
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: USAGE_CODE
columns.description: Historical rate usage (Average or Standard).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUTO_ROLL_FORWARD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if Historical Rates or Amounts of type historical and prior will automatically roll forward to following periods.
